# Moth People
## General information
Their wings give them better acceleration in zero-gravity environments, though like other species, they still can't move without equipment or a nearby surface when floating out in space.
Their specialized digestive systems can only process cotton and cotton-based items (such as cloth, clothing, towels, and MRE wrappers), rather than any food that other species would consider "edible".
Their insect blood isn't iron-based, and therefore isn't replenished when metabolizing iron.
They take [color=#1e90ff]30% less Cold damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]20% more Heat damage[/color]. Their fluff makes them prefer a somewhat colder temperature range than humans, and also makes them [color=#ffa500]extremely vulnerable to fire[/color].
